paragraphs.en: The little prince crossed the desert and encountered a single flower with three petals.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子穿越了沙漠，遇到了一朵三瓣花。

paragraphs.en: "Where are the men?" asked the little prince politely.
paragraphs.zh: “男士们在哪里？”小王子礼貌地问道。

paragraphs.en: The flower, recalling an encounter years ago, responded, "Men? I believe there are six or seven in existence. The last time I saw them was several years back.
paragraphs.zh: 花朵回忆起多年前的一次相遇，回答说：“男人？依我所知，现在大约有六七个吧。上次见到他们还是几年前的事了。”

paragraphs.en: They're hard to find; the wind carries them away and they have no roots."
paragraphs.zh: 它们很难留存；风一吹就没了，根也扎不深。

paragraphs.en: With a sigh, the little prince said goodbye.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子叹了口气，告别离去。
